about_the_game:
Myrkwood: Offshoot is a top-down survival defense game that you can play with your friends! Spawn with 5 other people and defend the objective, the Gem, as Bombrats and hordes of monsters attempt to try to crack it. Dodge, slash, & fight as you attempt to try to get the highest waves survived.

Features

  • Online/local multiplayer - You and 5 other players can join the same lobby and defend the Gem together!

  • Upgrade your character! Buy upgrades & items to help you defend the Gem!

  • Chat with friends! Chat with your friends to help coordinate and communicate better!

  • Nice pixel art graphics! Well, at least we think so. 

  • Endless waves! Fight through endless waves with increasing difficulty. 

  • Dungeon crawler! Run through endless rooms & fight through hordes of monsters as you try to get the highest completed room counts. 

  • Enemy variants! Enemies become more difficult by becoming stronger and having multiple powers to try to kill you! :)
